==Notes==
*Amalek may be killed by  groups of [[Tengu]] or [[Mergoyle]]s before you reach him.  If that happens, and you have the [[Wanted by the Shining Blade|bounty]] for him in your quest log, it will update and be counted as complete.
*Only appears at location after viewing the first Talmark Wilderness Shining Blade Camp scene.

==Trivia==
*Amalek is probably named after the infamous Biblical [[Wikipedia:Amalek|Amalek]] people, who were known as bandits that roamed ancient [[Wikipedia:Canaan|Canaan]] and its surrounding areas.
